verdict.rationale: Fireworks AI is an API platform, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only says the REST API is used 'using an API Key'. Nothing documents per-key scopes, role restrictions, model or deployment limits, or least-privilege service accounts for agents. The account-level monthly spend limit is a related control, not a credential-scoping capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
